description: Collapse the host nav SELECTION + STATE onto the stable graph Features. The host stamps each Feature's reach_dist (from the graph-resident cortex relax) — mechanical I/O — and these rules DECIDE graph-natively: select_nav_target (nearest reachable unresolved un-abandoned Feature), untarget_nav, nav_progress (stuck when reach_dist stops improving), nav_abandon (stuck>=4 -> give up). The host then only reads `is_nav_target` and emits the cortex hop. visited/nav_done/progress/selection now live as graph data on durable Features — no Python nav decision. | EXPLORE-FRONTIER now a seed rule too: select_explore_target (when no feature targeted, the nearest reachable UNVISITED non-wall Locus) + untarget_explore. The host's last selection loop is gone. + stuck-exploration fix: game_still frame-stamps the last visited-growth; explore_abandon (stuck>=4) abandons the wedged frontier; abandon_spread floods the pocket by reachable-shadow; reopen_frontier EAGERLY lifts abandon when the avatar repositions (neighbour now closer than the abandon floor) keeping the quarantine transient; region_understood flags the all-explored terminal. + oscillation fix: deleted reopen's tautological relative-reach disjunct; quarantine now clocked (abandon_frame+COOLDOWN=8) or wall-clear; explore_abandon guarded abandoned==0; dropped abandon_spread (wall-segment marking handles pockets at the source); select_explore_fallback patrols the oldest quarantine; frontier_exhausted is the clean terminal.
